text:
maria: quick flag — canary restores from the object-store are failing with KMS Decrypt errors after the RBAC tidy-up last night. restoring job log shows: `AccessDeniedException: kms:Decrypt` and no grant id in agent logs. :grimacing:

rohit: Did we rename any roles? we did a small cleanup that collapsed 'infra-canary-restore' into 'infra-canary'.

maria: yep. restore-worker tries to create ephemeral grants but i don't see CreateGrant in the agent trace for the failing runs. cloudtrail shows createGrant for the OLD principal at 2024-11-14T01:02:11Z. No createGrant for new arn.

kms-watchbot: [alert] Key alias/rdw-canary-snapshots: high missing-grant rate (5 failures / 10m).

leo: Possible scenario: agent created grants for infra-canary-restore earlier, then RBAC rename made that principal non-existent; later restores assume they can create grants under new principal but agent's retry logic suppressed grant creation because it thought grants existed.

oncall-engsec: Can we get the minimal logs and the S3 head-object metadata? Also check if any objects were uploaded with SSE-C or had missing x-amz-server-side-encryption header.

maria: paste: 
```
2024-11-14T01:05:03Z restore-worker[pid=77]: restore failed: kms.DecryptAccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::999888:assumed-role/infra-canary/restore is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888:key/aa11bb22-cc33
Cause: grantId not found
```

rohit: run: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/rdw-canary-snapshots --region us-west-2` and grep for granteePrincipal. If empty, recreate grant.

leo: Also check the backup-agent's local sqlite for lastGrantId if we still persist it — iirc we removed persistent grant storage to avoid statefulness, which now bites us.

backup-bot: [incident] canary-restore-errors count=9. Created ticket SEC-2319.

maria: confirmed list-grants returns empty. cloudtrail correlation: createGrant for old principal at 2024-11-13T22:41:11Z, then role rename at 2024-11-14T00:00:02Z. No subsequent createGrant.

rohit: short-term: create a grant for the new principal and test restores. sample: 
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/rdw-canary-snapshots \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::999888:role/infra-canary \
  --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --region us-west-2
```

oncall-engsec: Find root cause: agent retry semantics + RBAC rename produced an orphaned-grant condition. Risk: snapshots become unreadable (availability) and auditors will flag unexplained downtime (compliance). We need a follow-up plan.

leo: Proposed mitigation roadmap: 
- persist grantId and KMS key id in snapshot metadata right after grant creation (agent change) (owner: rohit).
- pre- and post-RBAC migration hook: script to re-issue grants for all active restore principals (owner: infra-team).
- CI gating: any IAM role rename PR must include a ksm-grant migration checklist (owner: security).
- S3 uploader fix: ensure multipart retries preserve SSE headers (owner: storage-team).

maria: after we re-created grant and forced a restore, canary restore succeeded. added a smoke test to the restore pipeline.

backup-bot: [note] restored count=1 for canary-2024-11-13T21:00Z snapshot.

rohit: additional notes from quick audit: some snapshots older than 90d still reference legacy CMK alias/rdw-legacy-key. need migration plan to copy grant mappings or re-encrypt. (owner: leo).

oncall-engsec: Action items before we close SEC-2319: 
- rohit: PR to backup-agent to persist grant ids and emit metric when grants are missing (ETA: 3d).
- infra-team: pre-rotation playbook (add to ops-runbooks) for role renames (ETA: 5d).
- storage-team: multipart SSE header retention patch (ETA: 4d).
- leo: legacy-key migration plan and compliance note for auditors (ETA: 7d).

maria: filing incident note in #incidents and scheduling a follow-up review. tagging infra for the pre-rotation hook design. thanks for the quick responses. :thumbsup:
